name: Product Launch Checklist
description: A product launch checklist covering positioning, assets, pricing, launch day and post-launch follow-up.

items.text: Define your target customer and the core problem you solve.
Write a clear positioning statement and value proposition.
List your key differentiators against alternatives.
Craft the headline message and supporting talking points.
Agree on the product name, tagline and key benefits.
Set pricing and any launch-period discount or bonus.
Define the packages, tiers or bundles you will offer.
Confirm checkout, billing and refund processes work.
Prepare answers to likely pricing and value objections.
Set a goal for launch sales or signups.
Build or update the product or landing page.
Prepare product images, demo video and screenshots.
Write the launch announcement and email sequence.
Create social posts and any paid ad creative.
Prepare a press kit or media outreach list if relevant.
Draft FAQ and support documentation for new customers.
Choose the channels you will use to reach your audience.
Warm up your email list and audience before the date.
Line up partners, influencers or affiliates to amplify.
Schedule announcement posts and emails in advance.
Brief your sales and support teams on the launch.
Confirm the product page and checkout are live and working.
Send the launch email to your list.
Publish your social and community announcements.
Turn on any scheduled ads and monitor early performance.
Watch for and respond quickly to questions and issues.
Track sales and signups against your goal in real time.
Thank early customers and request reviews or testimonials.
Monitor support tickets and fix any urgent issues fast.
Follow up with leads who showed interest but did not buy.
Analyze launch results against your goals.
Document lessons learned for your next launch.
Plan ongoing marketing to sustain post-launch momentum.

faq.q: What should a product launch checklist include?
faq.a: It should cover positioning and messaging, pricing and offers, marketing and sales assets, the channels you will use, a coordinated launch-day plan, and post-launch follow-up to gather feedback and sustain momentum.

faq.q: How far in advance should I start a product launch?
faq.a: Start planning several weeks to a few months ahead depending on scope. Use the planning and asset sections early so launch day is about execution, not last-minute creation.

faq.q: Is this product launch checklist good for beginners?
faq.a: Yes. It lays out each phase in clear steps, so a first-time founder or small business can run a coordinated launch without missing positioning, assets or follow-up.

faq.q: Can I download this product launch checklist as a PDF?
faq.a: Yes. You can print it or download it as a PDF to coordinate your marketing, sales and product teams during the launch.

faq.q: What should I do after launch day?
faq.a: After launch, monitor sales and feedback, respond to questions and reviews, fix early issues quickly, thank early customers, and analyze results to plan your next campaign.
